texts.010afc47f810: Provide an abstract which summarises the aims of the study.  The primary objectives of the MRC/BHF Heart protection Study are to asses, in a wide range of patients at high risk of coronary heart disease (CHD) to whom this may be importantly relevant, the effects of: simvastatin, a drug that produces a substantial reduction in cholesterol, on total and cause specific mortality; and supplementation with the antioxident vitamins E and C and B-carotene, on total and fatal CHD.  Secondary objectives include assesment of the effects of the study treatments on CHD mortality and morbidity in the first few years, and in various seperate catergories of patient assesment of their effects on the incidence of cancer, strokes, major vascular procedures and other conditions that require hospitalisation.  The effects of the study treatments on cause specific mortality and morbidity during longer term follow-up will also be assessed.
